edges.reason: msg.sender is used directly as the key of addressToGoldDeposit in transferDeposit, tying deposit accounting to caller identity.
withdrawDeposit uses msg.sender to look up and debit addressToGoldDeposit.
updateRecord is gated by onlyAccessDeploy which checks msg.sender == owner or deployAccess[msg.sender].
levelUp is guarded by onlyOwnerOf(_tokenId), comparing msg.sender with the token owner.
swap is guarded by onlyOwnerOf(_tokenId) requiring msg.sender to own the card escaping the burn.
Gold.mint is gated by onlyAccessMint which inspects msg.sender.
CryptoSagaCard.mint is gated by onlyAccessMint which inspects msg.sender.
BasicToken.transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so authorisation is implicit in the caller identity.
transferFrom uses allowed[_from][msg.sender] as the allowance source, keyed by the caller.
transferOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
claimOwnership is restricted by onlyPendingOwner comparing msg.sender to pendingOwner.
swapCardForReward uses the onlyCard modifier checking msg.sender == cardAddess.
addExp is restricted by onlyAccessDeploy which inspects msg.sender.
addDeposit is restricted by onlyAccessDeposit which inspects msg.sender.
random() mixes now into the seed, making the generated hero IVs dependent on block.timestamp.
levelUp requires _heroInstance.availableAt <= now, a block.timestamp dependency.
updateRecord emits UpdateLeaderboard with now as the recorded date.
deploy requires _heroInstance.availableAt <= now and stores now + _duration.
mint initialises HeroInstance.availableAt with now.
transferDeposit performs the external call goldContract.transferFrom inside the function body.
addressToGoldDeposit[msg.sender] += _amount is executed only after the external transferFrom returns, so a malicious Gold token can re-enter before accounting settles.
withdrawDeposit performs the external call goldContract.transfer before touching its own state.
The deposit balance is decremented only after the external transfer, so re-entering withdrawDeposit drains addressToGoldDeposit repeatedly.
The external Gold transfer callback can re-enter withdrawDeposit before the deposit balance is decremented.
swap invokes swapContract.swapCardForReward on an owner-controlled external contract.
The external swapCardForReward callback can re-enter CryptoSagaCard.swap before _burn completes.
The untrusted external call return value is assigned to the _rewardId local.
random() derives its output from blockhash and now, producing a miner-influenced pseudo-random value.
The predictable value is written into the seed state variable, making later rolls reproducible.
updateRecord performs unchecked uint32 additions and subtractions when adjusting Elo ratings.
Unchecked Elo arithmetic writes into addressToElo, where underflow/overflow silently corrupts ratings.
addDeposit performs an unchecked += over caller-supplied _amount.
The unchecked increment can overflow addressToGoldDeposit, inflating a player's recorded deposit.
levelUp deducts requiredGold from addressToGoldDeposit with raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
Gold.mint computes totalSupply_ = totalSupply_.add(_amount), a supply mint controlled by access lists.
Gold.mint credits balances[_to] with _amount through SafeMath.add.
addToken increments totalTokens via SafeMath.add.
removeToken decrements totalTokens via SafeMath.sub.
ERC721Token.transfer delegates to clearApprovalAndTransfer.
takeOwnership delegates to clearApprovalAndTransfer after the isApprovedFor check.
clearApprovalAndTransfer calls addToken for the recipient.
clearApprovalAndTransfer calls removeToken for the sender.
clearApprovalAndTransfer clears the pending approval before moving the token.
CryptoSagaHero.mint calls random() to roll the IVs of the new hero.
mint writes the freshly built HeroInstance into tokenIdToHeroInstance.
mint increments the numberOfTokenIds serial counter.
defineType writes the new HeroClass struct into heroClasses.
defineType increments numberOfHeroClasses after registering the class.
swap reads the swapContract address and requires it to be non-zero.
swap reads tokenIdToRank[_tokenId] to determine the reward rank.
CryptoSagaCard.mint uses and increments the numberOfTokenId counter.
CryptoSagaCard.mint stores _rank into tokenIdToRank for each new card.
setCryptoSagaCardSwapContract is onlyOwner and can point swapContract at an arbitrary contract.
grantAccessDeposit is onlyOwner and writes depositAccess.
revokeAccessDeposit is onlyOwner and writes depositAccess.
grantAccessDeploy is onlyOwner and writes deployAccess.
grantAccessMint is onlyOwner and writes mintAccess, which gates all minting.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner address after an onlyOwner check.
claimOwnership promotes pendingOwner to owner and clears it.
pause is onlyOwner and sets paused = true, stopping deposit and battle flows.
unpause is onlyOwner and clears the paused flag.
approve writes tokenApprovals only after onlyOwnerOf validation.
updateRecord calls updateLeaderboard for both the enemy and the caller.
updateLeaderboard pushes into or replaces entries of leaderBoardPlayers.
updateLeaderboard keeps addressToIsInLeaderboard in sync with the array.
updateLeaderboard scans addressToElo values to find the minimum rating used for replacement.
updateRecord pushes or pops entries of the recentPlayers queue.
getCorrectedStats reads hero data through the heroContract reference.
getCorrectedStats uses var tuple destructuring and adds _ivs into _currentStats without bounds checks.
levelUp reads heroClasses to obtain base stats and the max level cap.
levelUp mutates the stored HeroInstance level, stats and experience.
addExp mutates HeroInstance.currentExp of the targeted token.
_newExp holds the computed experience before it is validated and stored.
deploy writes lastLocationId and availableAt into the HeroInstance mapping.
_duration is supplied by the privileged caller and forms the availability window.
_amount parameter of transferDeposit flows into the caller's deposit balance.
_amount parameter of withdrawDeposit is the amount pushed out by the external transfer.
_amount bounds the mint loop in CryptoSagaCard.mint.
_rank is persisted into tokenIdToRank for every minted card.
_tokenId selects the card to swap and is validated by onlyOwnerOf.
_heroClassId indexes heroClasses and must be below numberOfHeroClasses in mint.
_myAddress is the caller-side player in updateRecord.
_enemyAddress is the opponent player in updateRecord.
_ownerOfToken is used as the key whose addressToGoldDeposit balance is debited in levelUp.
_rewardId is returned from swap after being computed by the external swap call.

The parameter is solely the loop bound of CryptoSagaCard.mint.

The parameter is only stored by CryptoSagaCard.mint into tokenIdToRank.
The parameter is only used as heroClasses index inside CryptoSagaHero.mint.
The parameter only feeds the availableAt computation of CryptoSagaHero.deploy.
The parameter represents the caller-side player inside updateRecord.
The parameter represents the opponent player inside updateRecord.
The local only holds ownerOf(_tokenId) so levelUp can debit the correct deposit entry.
The local only captures the return value of the external swapCardForReward call.
The local only stages the experience sum validated within CryptoSagaHero.addExp.
